subject: API endpoint for historical exports data
body: Is there an API endpoint that returns metadata about past scheduled exports - status, run time, row count - rather than just the export files themselves? Want to build a small internal monitor so we know if an export silently fails without having to check manually each time.

subject: Export monitoring idea from November - now more relevant
body: The metadata endpoint question from November is still open on our side, and it's become more relevant since we've now had two exports silently fail without any indication in the platform itself - we only noticed because the files were missing from the shared drive. We looked briefly at Storsund BI's export logging as a point of comparison while thinking this through. Would appreciate progress on either the endpoint or a built-in failure notification, whichever is more feasible soon.

subject: Export monitoring - we've built our own for now
body: Following up on the export visibility questions from the past few months - we've ended up building a lightweight internal script that checks the shared drive for expected files each morning and pings us if something's missing, so we're covered regardless of what happens on the platform side. Separately, a couple of dashboard widgets have also been rendering with a one-day lag recently, but given we've already built our own monitoring layer around exports, this isn't high priority for us to chase further right now.

subject: New connector for internal database
body: We want to connect a Postgres instance we run internally rather than one of the listed SaaS sources. Is a generic database connector supported?

subject: Export retention policy
body: How long are scheduled exports retained before they're purged from history? Want to know if we need to archive them ourselves.

subject: SSO setup question
body: Looking into enabling SSO for our account, does it support SAML, and is there a setup guide we can follow internally?

subject: Alert on connector failure
body: Is there a built-in alert type specifically for connector failures, or do we need to build a custom one around the sync status?

subject: SSO follow-up
body: SSO is working well since we set it up last month. One question, can we enforce it for all users, or is it optional per login?

subject: API access for the Postgres connector data
body: Now that the Postgres connector is running, we'd like to also pull the same data via API for a separate internal report. Is that data exposed the same way?

subject: Dashboard performance with large datasets
body: Our largest dashboard has grown to cover about two years of data and is noticeably slower to load. Any recommended way to structure it for better performance?

subject: Export retention policy question
body: How long are scheduled export files retained on your servers before they're purged? We'd like to understand this before we finalise our own archiving policy, particularly for statutory financial reports we need to retain for several years regardless of what's kept on your side.

subject: Dashboard refresh delay during month-end
body: During month-end close specifically, our main finance dashboards have been taking noticeably longer to refresh - sometimes 10 minutes or more - compared to the rest of the month. It's not blocking us, but it's inconvenient during the one period where timing actually matters most. Is this a known load pattern across your customer base at month-end, or something specific to our account?

subject: Report builder - scenario modelling question
body: We're exploring whether report builder can support simple scenario toggles - for instance, switching a report between actuals and a forecast variant using the same layout - rather than maintaining two separate templates. We had a look at how Dashlume handles this during a broader tooling review this quarter, mainly to understand what's realistic to expect from a platform at this level.

subject: Export retention answer from last year, and month-end update
body: Realised we never got a firm answer on the export retention question from last summer, though we've since built our own archive by saving statutory exports to internal storage as they run, so it's no longer something we need urgently. Separately, the month-end dashboard refresh delay from May is still there, but our finance team has adjusted timing around it rather than waiting. Our tooling review, which has touched on Dashlume among others, continues in the background, but nothing is being decided in a hurry.

subject: Connector for new subsidiary
body: We've onboarded a new subsidiary with its own ERP instance. Can we connect it as a separate source while keeping consolidated reporting across both?

subject: Seat allocation across subsidiaries
body: Following on from the new subsidiary connector, how do seat licences work when users need access across both entities? Do they need two seats?

subject: Consolidated export across entities
body: Is there a way to produce one export that consolidates data across both our entities, or do we need to run two separate exports and merge them ourselves?

subject: Export currency conversion
body: For the consolidated export, can the platform apply a currency conversion automatically, or should we handle that downstream?

subject: Export schedule adjustment
body: Want to move our monthly consolidated export to run a day later to align with our new subsidiary's close date. Can you adjust the schedule?

subject: Dashboard access for subsidiary finance lead
body: Our subsidiary's finance lead needs read access to the consolidated dashboard but not the underlying detail views. Is that level of restriction possible?

subject: Report builder throwing errors mid-build
body: Report builder is erroring out partway through building a multi-page report, no clear error message. Losing time on this, please look today.

subject: Same report builder error, two days later
body: The error from Wednesday is back, different report this time. Starting to suspect it's not an isolated bug.

subject: Dashboards down same day as the report builder issue
body: On top of the report builder problem I just raised, dashboards have now gone down too. Not a good afternoon.

subject: Dashboards again
body: Dashboards are acting up again, two days after the last fix. Please check if it's the same underlying cause.

subject: Third dashboard ticket this week
body: Third one on dashboards in a week now, different symptom, tiles rendering with wrong data this time. Needs a proper look, not just a restart.

subject: Seat invite not arriving
body: Invited a new team member last week, invite email never arrived. Resent twice. Can you check on your end?

subject: Export corrupted file
body: Today's scheduled export came through as a corrupted file, won't open in Excel or anything else. Need a clean re-export.

subject: Alerts firing twice
body: Our alerts have started firing twice for every threshold breach, cluttering inboxes. Minor but annoying, please fix the duplication.

subject: Report builder error, back for year-end
body: The same save error from the summer is back, right in time for year-end reporting. Please tell me this is finally getting a permanent fix.

subject: Admin panel not saving role changes
body: Changed a user's role from viewer to editor and it reverted itself an hour later. Happened twice now.

subject: Dashboards slow during month-end
body: Dashboards crawling during our busiest reporting week, obviously. Please prioritise given the timing.

subject: API returning stale data
body: API responses are lagging behind the UI by what looks like a day. Breaking our downstream automation.

subject: The role revert issue is back
body: The role-reverting bug from December has come back, same symptom, different user this time.

subject: Dashboards down, third issue this week
body: Dashboards now down completely, following the API and admin issues already reported this week. Rough stretch for us again.

subject: Alerts silent during the dashboard outage
body: While dashboards were down yesterday, none of the failure alerts fired either. That's exactly when we'd need them.

subject: Connector dropped overnight
body: Connector failed to sync overnight, first issue in a few months at least. Please check the logs.

subject: Report builder crash, familiar error
body: The recurring save error is back in report builder. I've stopped being surprised at this point but would still like it looked at properly.

subject: Export missing rows
body: Today's export is short by what looks like a few hundred rows compared to the dashboard totals. Need this checked before we send it externally.

subject: Dashboards down for year-end, again
body: Dashboards down right at year-end, same as always seems to happen. Appreciate the quick turnaround your team usually manages, just wish it didn't keep happening at the worst possible time.

subject: Scheduled export failing silently
body: The nightly export to our warehouse has failed twice this week with no error message in the log, just missing files. Second time this has happened this quarter. Can someone actually look at why it fails instead of just re-running it?

subject: Connector sync dropping rows again
body: Same pattern as the export issue last month - the Salesforce connector sync completed but roughly 200 rows are missing from the destination table. No error thrown. Second connector-adjacent problem in three weeks.

subject: API returning 500s on report endpoint
body: Getting intermittent 500 errors calling the reports endpoint since this morning. Happening maybe 1 in 10 calls. Need this stable before our board pack goes out Friday.

subject: Connector broken again - third time this quarter
body: The same connector that broke in February is down again, and it took your team ten days to sort out the API issue right before this one. We can't run a reporting pipeline on a tool that drops data silently every few weeks. Need a real fix, not a workaround.

subject: Broken again. One week after 'fixed'.
body: Fixed last Monday. Broken again today. Same connector. I don't have confidence in this component right now.

subject: Export queue stuck for weeks - still no fix
body: The export queue backing up that we reported back in January has come back, stuck since early April, with barely any update from support in between. Thirty days to close this out is not acceptable. We're now manually pulling data because we can't trust the scheduler.

subject: Escalating - connector issues since January, need account manager involved
body: I'd like this escalated beyond the support queue. Since January we've had recurring connector and export failures, five tickets, most requiring workarounds rather than fixes. Please loop in our account manager; we need a proper root-cause conversation, not another patch.

subject: Exports down again, one week after the escalation call
body: Following last week's call, exports failed again this morning. I understood the connector work was supposed to stabilise this. Still waiting on a concrete timeline.

subject: Seat count wrong on top of everything else
body: Now our seat count in admin shows two fewer licenses than we're paying for. On its own this would be a minor ticket, but combined with the unresolved export problem it's hard to feel like anything is under control on our account right now.

subject: Export fix confirmed
body: Good news - the export queue has been stable all week since the patch went in. Also appreciate someone finally sorting the seat count. Thank you.

subject: Alert threshold not triggering
body: Separate small one - a usage alert we set up isn't firing at the threshold we configured. Not urgent given everything else has calmed down, but flagging it while things are on a roll.

subject: Second alert also not firing
body: The fix for the last alert seems to have surfaced the same bug on a different alert rule. Support turned it around quickly again though, appreciated.

subject: Export scheduling enhancement idea
body: Now that exports are behaving, would it be possible to add a retry-with-notification option to the scheduler? Not a bug report, just a suggestion from someone who's spent too long staring at that queue this year.

subject: Question on role permissions
body: Trying to set up a more restrictive role for a contractor and can't find where to limit export access specifically. Might just be me missing a setting - pointer appreciated.

subject: Report builder filter not saving
body: A saved filter in report builder isn't persisting between sessions. Small thing, easy to work around, but worth a look.

subject: Export formatting question
body: Quick one - is there a way to set the default currency format on scheduled exports account-wide rather than per report? Nothing broken, just tidying things up on our end.

subject: API token expiring unexpectedly
body: Our integration token seems to be expiring well before the stated 90 days - had to regenerate it twice this month. Can you check the expiry logic on our account?

subject: New connector setup for NetSuite
body: Trying to set up the NetSuite connector and it's failing at the OAuth step. Following the setup guide exactly, so might be something on your end.

subject: Adding two new users
body: Need two new analyst seats added under our Enterprise plan, same permission set as our existing analysts please.

subject: Xero connector not syncing this week
body: The Xero connector hasn't pulled new invoice data since Tuesday. Nothing's changed on our end that we're aware of.

subject: Dashboard widget showing wrong currency
body: One of our cash flow widgets is displaying figures in USD instead of EUR. Everything else on the dashboard is correct.

subject: API documentation for budget endpoint
body: Can't find documentation for the budget-vs-actual endpoint mentioned in the changelog. Is it live yet?

subject: Report builder crashing on large table
body: Building a report with a wide table, 40+ columns, causes the builder to freeze. Works fine with fewer columns.

subject: SSO login issue for finance team
body: Three of our finance team members can't log in via SSO since this morning, get redirected back to the login page. Everyone else is fine.

subject: Dashboard sharing link expired
body: The shared dashboard link we send to our board members has stopped working. Can we get a fresh one, ideally one that doesn't expire?

subject: Report builder - pivot table totals wrong
body: Noticed the grand total row on a pivot table report doesn't match the sum of the visible rows. Been a while since our last ticket in the spring but this one's been bugging our year-end prep.

subject: Deactivating former employee's account
body: Please deactivate the account for a colleague who left last week - want to make sure the seat is freed up for backfill.

subject: Custom formula not calculating correctly
body: A custom formula field in one of our reports is returning blank for about half the rows, no obvious pattern to which ones.

subject: Report builder - date filter defaulting wrong
body: New reports default the date filter to last calendar year instead of current. Easy enough to change manually but happening on every new report now.

subject: Alert email going to spam
body: Our threshold alerts are landing in spam for a couple of recipients. Can you check if anything changed with the sending domain?

subject: CSV export missing header row
body: Exports to CSV from the operations dashboard are coming through without column headers. PDF exports are fine.

subject: Alert recipient list needs updating
body: Need to swap two people on the low-stock alert distribution list - one has moved teams.

subject: Export job timing out on large dataset
body: The monthly ops export has started timing out since we added the new warehouse location data. Worked fine as of Q3 last year.

subject: Dashboard not refreshing overnight
body: Our main ops dashboard is showing yesterday's data even after the scheduled refresh should have run. Manual refresh works fine.

subject: API — OAuth token scope documentation unclear
body: Hello, the OAuth scope documentation for the API is incomplete — several endpoints listed in the API reference are not covered by any of the documented scopes. We are unable to determine the correct scope to request for the data export endpoints in particular. Could you provide complete scope-to-endpoint mapping, or point us to the correct documentation? Ville Lehtinen, IT Manager.

subject: Large export jobs not completing — timeout after 30 min
body: Hi, exports on our larger reports are timing out after approximately 30 minutes with no file produced. Smaller reports export fine. The reports in question have around 50,000 rows. We need this to work for our quarterly reporting cycle which starts next week. Ville Lehtinen, IT Manager.

subject: Alerts — still no resolution on documentation issue, and now a new problem
body: Hi, the API scope documentation issue from July is still outstanding. In the meantime I have a separate issue: alert webhook delivery is failing for one of our notification channels. The endpoint is correct and returns 200 to test payloads from other systems. We need this working as part of our operational monitoring setup. Ville Lehtinen, IT Manager.

subject: Large export issue recurred — thought this was fixed
body: The large export timeout issue is back. I thought this was resolved in August but the same failure is happening again with the same report. 50,000 rows, times out after 30 minutes. This is our quarterly reporting period and we cannot have this failing. I would like to understand whether the fix applied in August was temporary, and what the permanent solution is. Ville Lehtinen.

subject: API issues accumulating — escalating
body: We have had unresolved or recurring issues with this platform since July. The API documentation is still incomplete five months on, the export timeout has recurred, and now we have a new API issue: the data refresh endpoint is returning stale data — the response shows a timestamp consistent with a 6-hour-old cache. Our integrations are building on top of unreliable data. I want this escalated to someone with the authority to fix it, not just acknowledge it. Ville Lehtinen, IT Manager.

subject: Export timeout again. Third time.
body: Export timeout on large report. Third time we have raised this. Still not fixed. Ville Lehtinen.

subject: Report builder — calculated field syntax query
body: Hi, I need to implement a conditional calculation in the Report builder — something like IF value > X THEN A ELSE B. Could you confirm the correct formula syntax for conditional logic? The documentation examples do not cover nested conditions. Ville Lehtinen, IT Manager.

subject: Export button doing nothing
body: Clicking export on the weekly summary report just spins and nothing downloads. Tried two browsers. Second export issue we've had this month.

subject: Alerts firing at wrong time of day
body: Our daily threshold alerts are arriving at 3am instead of 8am as configured. Woken up the whole team's phones a few nights running now.

subject: API integration down eight days and counting
body: Our order sync via the API has been broken for over a week now. We're a small team and this is genuinely holding up invoicing. Please treat this with urgency.

subject: Report builder losing formatting on save
body: Every time we save a report the conditional formatting resets. Third support ticket in two months and honestly starting to wonder if this product is stable enough for us.

subject: Escalating - API down again, same day as report bug
body: Same day as the formatting issue, the API sync has dropped out again. Between this and the last few weeks I need someone senior to actually own our account, not another queue ticket.

subject: Following up - still no resolution since March escalation
body: It's been months since we asked for this to be escalated properly and now the connector feeding our order data has failed too. We are a small operation and can't keep absorbing this. Need it fixed, and need to understand what's changed to actually prevent it recurring.

subject: Report builder stable - thank you
body: Wanted to say the formatting bug from the spring hasn't recurred since the July fix, and the new account contact has actually been really responsive. Small formula issue on one report this week but nothing like before.

subject: Export missing a column
body: Minor one - the weekly export is missing the region column. Given how smoothly the last couple of things have been handled, not worried this will drag on.

subject: Can we add a Slack alert option?
body: Loving how stable things have been the last couple of months. Any chance of adding Slack as an alert channel alongside email? Would help our small team a lot.

subject: Dashboard tile resizing oddly on tablet
body: Small cosmetic thing - a dashboard tile looks squashed when viewed on our warehouse tablet. Not urgent at all.

subject: Alert quiet hours request
body: Could we set quiet hours for alerts overnight? Team's happy with everything else, just don't need the 3am pings back.

subject: Connector question ahead of year-end
body: Just checking the order connector will handle the year-end date range correctly before we run our annual report. Everything's been running smoothly since the summer.

subject: API webhook support question
body: Does the platform support outbound webhooks that fire when a new report is generated, so we can trigger a downstream Slack notification automatically? Currently we're polling the API every 15 minutes to check for new reports, which feels inefficient if a webhook option already exists.

subject: Connector sync gaps - warehouse system
body: Our warehouse connector has had a few gaps over the past month where a day's worth of data simply doesn't appear in the sync, with no error or retry visible on our end. We've started keeping a parallel Excel log of daily totals pulled directly from the source system so we have something to reconcile against when this happens. Could you look into what might be causing the intermittent gaps?

subject: Connector gaps from August - update
body: The sync gaps we flagged in August haven't really gone away, but the parallel Excel log we set up has made it manageable - we just backfill the dashboard numbers from our own record on the days it happens. It's a few extra minutes of admin rather than a real blocker at this point, so we're not chasing a fix with any urgency. Wanted to close the loop on our end regardless.

subject: Removing a departed employee's seat
body: One of our team members has left the company - could you confirm the process for reassigning their seat licence to someone else, and whether any of their saved dashboards or report templates can be transferred to the new user rather than lost?

subject: Export file size limit reached unexpectedly
body: We tried exporting our full operations dataset for an annual review and got an error saying the file exceeds the size limit, though we didn't realise there was one until now - nothing in the export dialog mentioned it beforehand. Could you tell us what the actual limit is, and whether there's a way to split large exports automatically rather than us doing it manually by date range?

subject: API alternative for the large export problem
body: Following up on the export size limit from last month - we're now looking at pulling the data via the API in batches instead, since manual date-range splitting isn't sustainable for a report this size. Could you confirm the max response size per API call so we can plan the batching properly? We also had a quick look at how Storsund BI handles bulk data access, mostly for context on what's typical at this end of the market.

subject: Export and API workaround - settled for now
body: We've landed on a batching approach via the API that gets us the annual export data reliably, so the original size limit issue isn't blocking us anymore even though we never got a clear answer on raising it. Separately, we noticed the failure alert for the export job doesn't fire when the size limit is hit, which is really how this all started - but given we've moved to the API route anyway, it's low priority. Keeping half an eye on Storsund BI as part of general market awareness, nothing more than that for now.

subject: Cannot duplicate an existing report
body: The duplicate option on an existing report template throws an error instead of creating a copy. Works fine on other templates, just not this one.

subject: API key rotation instructions
body: Looking for documented steps to rotate our API key without downtime, couldn't find it in the help centre.

subject: Bulk user import failing
body: Trying to import 40 users via CSV under admin and it fails partway through with no clear error. Works fine for smaller batches.

subject: API webhook not firing
body: Configured a webhook for new report completion events last week and it hasn't fired once, even though reports are completing fine.

subject: Rate limit increase request
body: We're hitting our API rate limit during month-end processing. Can we get this raised for the Enterprise plan, or is there a scheduling workaround?

subject: SCIM provisioning question
body: Does the platform support SCIM for automated user provisioning from our identity provider? Trying to cut down manual admin work.

subject: Alert configuration UI not saving thresholds
body: Setting a custom threshold on an alert rule appears to save but reverts to default the next time I open it. Tried on two different browsers.

subject: SAP connector authentication error
body: New SAP connector setup is failing at authentication with a generic error code. Separately, never did hear back on whether that alert threshold bug from February ever got resolved, will chase separately if needed.

subject: Following up on alert threshold bug
body: Circling back - the alert threshold reset issue from earlier in the year is still there. Would like this properly closed out this time.

subject: Budget variance alert not triggering
body: Set a variance alert at 10% and it hasn't fired despite a category clearly over threshold this month. Double-checked the configuration.

subject: Bank feed connector duplicate transactions
body: The bank feed connector has started pulling in duplicate transactions for one of our accounts since last week's sync.

subject: Export decimal rounding off by one cent
body: Noticed the exported P&L report rounds a couple of line items differently than the on-screen version. Small but throws off our reconciliation.

subject: Second bank feed connector issue this month
body: Another connector hiccup, this time a different account entirely stopped syncing three days ago. Might be worth checking if there's a broader issue on your side.

subject: API access for new finance system
body: We're integrating a new AP system and need read access scoped to just the ledger endpoints. Is that configurable per key?

subject: Alert recipient not receiving emails
body: One recipient on our variance alert list isn't getting the emails, though they're clearly on the list. Others are fine.

subject: Report builder - currency symbol wrong on one report
body: One saved report shows the GBP symbol instead of EUR even though the underlying data and account settings are EUR.

subject: Dashboard load time has gotten noticeably slower
body: Over the last couple of weeks our main finance dashboard has been taking 20-30 seconds to load, versus a few seconds before. Nothing changed on our end that we know of.

subject: Following up - dashboard still slow
body: Wanted to check in on the slow-loading dashboard from a couple of weeks back, still an issue, worth flagging again in case it got lost.
